# Preeti Scaffolding

Preeti Scaffolding is a Mumbai-based scaffolding service provider operated by Vijay Shukla.

Official website: https://www.shuklascaffolding.com/

## Services

- Scaffolding material rental
- Scaffolding material sales
- H-Frame and MS H-Frame scaffolding
- Cuplock scaffolding and stairway systems
- Scaffolding ladders and accessories
- Scaffolding erection labour
- Scaffolding dismantling labour

## Location and service area

The business is based at A 4/8, Jai Hind Society, Khadi No. 03, 90 Ft Road, Sakinaka, Kurla West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400072. Service is available across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai according to project requirements.
